newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly higher.

text.p: May 1 - IMM currency futures finished mostly higher, with Can dollars leading gains. Traders said funds were active buyers into the close, pushing June to $0.7235. Sterling was mostly flat ahead of the results of the British elections. U.S. April employment data will be released at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT on Friday. (Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
